Join our professional, highly qualified team: take on challenges, share your knowledge, learn new things, and discover your potential!Your tasksWe are looking for a Technical Product Owner with a strong technical mindset to drive the evolution of our Z1 Appliance – the virtual foundation for our server-based security products and services. business teams, you gather requirements from stakeholders and the market and translate them into clear project specifications- In alignment with our company goals and in close collaboration with the business teams, you develop and own the vision and roadmap for your platform components- You break down complex feature ideas into epics and user stories with clear acceptance criteria- You keep the backlog consistently up to date and well prioritized for your development team- To ensure strong usability, you create lightweight mockups yourself and coordinate mockups and prototypes for larger features with our UI/UX designers- You conduct market and competitive analyses to support the platform strategy- You maintain technology partnerships with virtualization and cloud infrastructure providers and build new collaborationsYour profile- You have at least 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role within an agile team- You bring a strong technical understanding- Writing epics, user stories, and bug reports comes naturally to you- You are familiar with Debian Linux as well as modern technologies such as microservices, container technologies (Docker Swarm, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructures- Concepts such as clustering, load balancing, multi-tenancy, storage services, and high availability are not new to you- Very good English skills (at least C1) enable smooth collaboration in international teams   Nice to Have:- Understanding of the design and operation of SaaS infrastructures- Hands-on experience with UX mockup tools such as Figma or Adobe XD- German language skillsWe offer:- Flexible hours and home office options- Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking- Subsidies for meals: (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet- Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness- Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office- Get-togethers: monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party- Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals- Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential- International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative cultureIf that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.Want to know more? jobs.description: Welcome to Bosch!At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.The Robert Bosch GmbH is looking forward to your application!Are you ready to shape the future of modern mobility systems by taking ownership of digital ASIC design? As an ASIC Digital Lead, you take technical responsibility for the digital design scope across complex ASIC projects. You ensure a consistent and high-quality implementation from specification to integration, actively contributing to the design while driving alignment across all stakeholders and supporting robust DFT and test strategies.In this position, you take technical responsibility for the digital design scope in ASIC projects, coordinating specification, development, and integration across all stakeholders. You align requirements, structure execution, and drive key technical decisions to ensure a robust and consistent digital implementation.You act as the central coordination point for all digital design activities, while also contributing hands-on to implementation, ensuring practical feasibility and high-quality results.Based on system requirements and project objectives, you derive, consolidate, and implement the digital design concept, ensuring consistency across all development phases.You ensure that DFT and ATPG aspects are properly integrated into the design within the project, planning and aligning activities and ensuring the achievement of defined coverage targets.Last but not least, you take project-spanning responsibility for the ATPG flow, ensuring its stable operation, continuous improvement, and consistent application across projects. You support project teams as an ATPG expert. By analyzing test patterns, silicon data, and defect signatures, you identify root causes and drive targeted improvements in design, test quality, and methodologies. Become part of an international environment where collaboration, continuous development and strong leadership make a real impact.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead, coach and develop Site Project Managers, Construction Managers and Chief Technical Field Advisors, strengthening their technical, project management and leadership capabilities through mentoring, knowledge sharing and best-practice transfer.* Build a collaborative, high-performing global Site Management team that promotes open communication, continuous learning and professional growth.* Strategically align global resources, competencies and staffing with project schedules and business priorities, ensuring effective resource planning and timely mobilization.* Drive talent acquisition and development, including recruitment, interviews, onboarding, succession planning and targeted individual development initiatives.* Partner with Project Management, HUB Managers and other functions to align demand, resources and priorities while standardizing processes to enhance safety, efficiency, quality and consistency across international sites.* Advise senior Erection and Commissioning management on resource availability, staffing risks, competencies and organizational performance, while championing Siemens Energy’s Zero Harm principles.What You Bring* A university degree in engineering, construction Site Managers and provide constructive, practical feedback.* Experience in multicultural environments, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach with strong independent decision-making capabilities.* Willingness to travel internationally (ca. 10 %) and engage directly with employees and project teams at construction sites; fluency in written and spoken English and German.About the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
